title: cordylanthus maritimus var. canescens
intro: Cordylanthus maritimus var. canescens, commonly known as the Beach Plume, is a plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. The Beach Plume is known for its medicinal properties, with health benefits attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of the Beach Plume are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the Beach Plume include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
